text:
emma: opened PR to update AuroraLite model card + migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4180. Main items: fix broken bench links, normalize model naming, update SDK v4 snippet, add embed-shard example.

jon: saw the preview, thanks. quick note: the card mixes 'AuroraLite-3B' and 'auroralite3b' in examples. runtime aliasing treats those differently in older clients. we should pick the Catalog display name and add an 'aliases' line.

kevin: SDK v4 changed the response shapeolder snippets assume resp['text'] but now it's resp['choices'][0]['message']['content']. i'll add a small example.

rosa: linkcheck failing on two items: /assets/bench/auroralite/latency.csv and https://storage.redwood.ai/models/auroralite/weights.tar.gz. infra prefers bench CSVs kept in docs repo and external weight links replaced with provenance notes.

infra-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links found (docs/auroralite/model-sources.md#L18, /assets/bench/auroralite/latency.csv). Recommendation: copy bench assets to docs/assets/bench/auroralite and replace absolute weight URL with provenance section.

emma: i'll remove the absolute weight URL and add a provenance block that points to the upstream model page + license.

kevin: SDK v4 snippet proposal (small): ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.generate(model="auroralite-3b", prompt="hi")
text = resp['choices'][0]['message']['content']
print(text)
```

jon: thanks kevin. also can we include a short YAML route example showing alias pinning? customers kept getting the hyphen mismatch.

kevin: yep. example: ```yaml
routes:
  - model: AuroraLite-3B
    aliases: [auroralite3b, auroralite-3b-int8]
    pinned_variant: auroralite3b-int8
```

rosa: will move latency.csv into docs/assets/bench/auroralite and update the PR links (ETA today). also will strip the storage.redwood.ai absolute path and replace with provenance entry.

emma: we also have an embed-shard example in the migration guide that uses an older chunking approach. can someone update to the new embed shard syntax? small snippet suggestion: ```python
# recommended embed sharding
embs = await client.embed(model="auroralite-3b", inputs=batch_of_texts, shard_strategy="balanced")
```

kevin: i'll add the shard example and a short note: "embed sharding reduces memory by splitting inputs across workers; see embed-shard docs link".

jon: one more bench note: the baseline table shows tokens/sec but the axis label was missing units. please clarify seq len (512) and batch (8) in the methodology section.

emma: adding a measurement-methods subsection with runner args and seed.

infra-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck: 1 broken link remains: https://storage.redwood.ai/models/auroralite/weights.tar.gz referenced in docs/model-sources.md.

emma: updated model-sources.md to remove direct weights link and point to the provenance block in the card.

rosa: pushed bench CSVs into docs/assets/bench/auroralite and updated the PR. CI running.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/auroralite-3b-card

emma: merging after CI green. will open a follow-up to add streaming SDK examples next sprint. thanks all. :rocket:
